conviction_note: Two-sided setup: the Q3 revenue bar (~$126.5M, +6% q/q) asks for more sequential growth than last year's summer quarter delivered (+1.9% q/q, against a consensus that then modelled -2.4%), and this name has sold every revenue miss hard (-8.4%, -14.1%), while the expected end of the German AMNOG price negotiation could release a conservatively set reserve; the miss risk outweighs slightly, but a ~10% short interest at 10 days to cover and modest beats being bought (+0.2% to +4.1%) keep p_up near 50 at 46 on an abs move of 8.5, so the scaled number (-0.68) sits a little more negative than the findings' sum (-0.20), which nets the Germany upside against the seasonality risk.

EPS per the 2026-10-26 preview https://www.itiger.com/news/1196620201 (the two agree within 0.4%); other aggregators run higher (Benzinga ~$128.6M, Chartmill ~$131.6M, per search snippets only). No company revenue guidance exists; only FY2026 non-GAAP R&D+SG&A $175-195M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001711279/000171127926000058/a2q26-ex991xpressrelease.htm). Revenue is the line this name trades on: Q2 2026 missed by about 1.4% ($119.2M vs $120.9M) and fell 8.37%.
positioning_check: Short interest 2,936,047 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 9.92% of shares outstanding, 10.33 days to cover, down 15.5% from 3,475,527 on 2026-09-30 (https://altindex.com/ticker/krys/short-interest, fetched 2026-10-30). Borrow fee shown at about 0.3% (curvedtrading.com snippet). So the options lean slightly negative, the short base is fairly crowded and was covering into the print, and the 5-day run-up has lifted the bar a little.

findings.finding: The Q3 revenue bar of about $126.5M is +6.1% on Q2's $119.2M, but in the same quarter last year Vyjuvek grew only +1.9% q/q ($96.0M to $97.8M), and management then cited summer therapy pauses and 'a bit lower' US sales. That year's consensus had modelled a q/q decline ($93.7M against $96.0M), and the quarter beat by 4.4%. This year's consensus assumes no summer dip on a US base of $91.6M, so a repeat of the seasonal pattern lands the quarter around $121-124M, a 2-4% miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue misses: Q1 2025 -10.6% on revenue gave -14.06% (2025-05-06); Q2 2026 -1.4% on revenue gave -8.37% (2026-08-03). Beats: Q3 2025 +4.4% gave +0.17%; Q4 2025 +1.7% gave +4.12%. Revenue misses are sold hard and beats bought mildly.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at +6% q/q, and higher at Benzinga and Chartmill, shows the street is not modelling a summer dip this year, unlike last year when it modelled a q/q decline. If the seasonal risk were priced, Q3 estimates would sit at or below Q2's $119-122M. The puts are bid only modestly (+4 vol points), and the stock is up 5% in five days into the print.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 consensus and actuals from a separate source: https://therighttrader.com/earnings-calendar/krys. US Q1 2026 $87.5M to Q2 $91.6M (+4.7% q/q) from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001711279/000171127926000044/a1q26exhibit991pr.htm shows the base is still growing, which tempers the size. This is an inference from last year's pattern, not a Q3 2026 data point.

findings.finding: Germany's AMNOG price negotiation for Vyjuvek should conclude around the Q3 print. The G-BA decision came on 2026-02-19 (procedure start 2025-08-15), so the six-month negotiation ran to about 2026-08-19. On the Q2 call management said it expected completion in Q3 and called its accrual 'conservative'. A full quarter of German price reserve had kept Q2 ex-US revenue flat at $27.6M (vs $28.9M in Q1), with 'maybe a partial' reserve in Q3 and normal German net revenue by Q4. The outcome, a final price at or above the accrual (reserve release, clean ex-US run-rate) or arbitration by the Schiedsstelle (overhang persists), is likely disclosed in the Q3 release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: ex-US revenue went flat on the German reserve and total revenue missed by 1.4%; the stock fell 8.37% on 2026-08-03. No earlier price-resolution event to compare against.
findings.why_not_priced: No German Erstattungsbetrag or Schiedsstelle decision has been published in any source found, and the 2026-10-28 Trefis note still lists the German negotiation as an open factor. A priced release would show up as Q3 estimates above $130M, or the stock recovering its August loss before the print. Consensus at $126.5M (+$7M q/q) does not clearly embed a catch-up.
findings.independence: G-BA procedure page confirming the decision date of 2026-02-19 and the procedure start of 2025-08-15: https://www.g-ba.de/bewertungsverfahren/nutzenbewertung/1250/. Q1 ex-US $28.9M: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001711279/000171127926000044/a1q26exhibit991pr.htm. Trefis 2026-10-28 also lists it as unresolved: https://www.trefis.com/stock/krys/articles/620966/has-the-story-under-krystal-biotech-stock-run-out/2026-10-28. This finding partly offsets finding 1 on total revenue; they are separate drivers (US seasonality vs the ex-US reserve).

findings.finding: Several guided pipeline catalysts could land in the Q3 business update: KB803 IOLITE Phase 3 top-line (fully enrolled April 2026, guided 4Q 2026), the KB407 cystic-fibrosis interim (before year end), the KB111 Hailey-Hailey interim (before year end), FDA alignment on the KB407 registrational design (4Q 2026), and the FDA path for KB113 after the 2026-10-15 Gorlin data (>80% lesion regression in 3 patients). Each is a binary with no knowable sign.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: KB113 positive data on 2026-10-15: the stock traded +0.7% to +3.0% intraday on the day (Benzinga, RTTNews snippets) and closed -4.07% at $316.58 on 2026-10-17 (sina.cn snippet). Pipeline news has moved this name little next to the revenue line.
findings.why_not_priced: The timing is guided and public; the outcome is not. Whether any readout comes on 2026-11-02 rather than later in Q4 is unknown. This adds to variance, not to the sign.

findings.finding: Short interest fell 15.5% to 2.94M shares (9.9% of shares outstanding) at the 2026-10-15 settlement, still 10.3 days to cover on about 250k shares a day. The stock rose 5.2% over the five sessions to 2026-10-30, consistent with covering into the print. A clean beat meets a crowded, slow-to-exit short base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No squeeze-type reaction in the six-print history; the largest upside reaction was +4.12% (2026-02-17).
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is public. Its effect is asymmetric: it caps the downside of a soft print less than it lifts a beat. The +4 skew shows the option market still leans down.
findings.independence: Baseline 5d run-up +5.24% and put/call OI 0.27 (sealed baseline). Days to cover from a second tracker, 10.3 at the 2026-08-14 settlement: https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/krys/short-interest/

findings.finding: The CEO (Krish Krishnan) and the President of R&D (Suma Krishnan) each sold about $9.0M of stock on 2026-09-04 at roughly $354-366, under 10b5-1 plans that continue a 2024-2025 pattern; no open-market buys.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observable link between these recurring plan sales and print reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: Public Form 4s, routine plan sales; close to fully priced. Filed for completeness.

findings.finding: The only approved competitor, Abeona's Zevaskyn (RDEB cell sheets), is ramping slowly: 12 patients treated since launch, 5 in Q2 2026 (only 4 revenue-recognised, $11.4M) and 3 in Q3 to date as of 2026-08-13. Competitive drag on Vyjuvek's Q3 US patient base is negligible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None; competition has not been cited as a cause of any KRYS reaction found.
findings.why_not_priced: Public and peripheral; this rules out a competitive-loss explanation for any US softness rather than adding upside.

outside_window.finding: Italy and Spain commercial launches are expected 'before year end' and the France price is expected in 2027. These shape Q4 2026 and 2027 ex-US revenue, not the Q3 print, unless the release dates them.

baseline_tension: The slight negative lean agrees with the +4.06 put skew but cuts against the +5.2% five-day run-up and a 10-day-to-cover short base that has been covering, so p_up is held at 46 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (crowded short, about 10 days to cover): shrank the seasonality negative from -2.0 to -1.5 and kept p_up at 46 rather than 45.
Rule 2 (one-offs): the German reserve release is partly a one-time catch-up, so the finding was cut from +1.0 to +0.8; it stays a guidance finding because it sets the ex-US run-rate for Q4.
Rule 5 (absence or weak signal is worth about 0): insider 10b5-1 sales cut from -0.2 to -0.1.
Rule 6 (verify the bar): two sources agree within 0.4% ($126.08M, $126.5M), so no cap applied; print_vs_bar eased from -1.5 to -1.0 because US Q1-to-Q2 growth of +4.7% tempers the seasonal read.
Rule 1 (reaction function): the asymmetric history (misses -8 to -14%, beats 0 to +4%) is kept in abs_move_pct 8.5 and in the size of finding 1; nothing else changed.
